Plugin registration error handling is a localized fix to httpie/plugins/registry.py. Requires adding try/except wrapper around plugin imports with appropriate logging/warning handling. Scoped to 1-2 files (registry.py and potentially a logging utility).

Nested JSON parsing error handling requires adding try/except blocks in parse.py and interpret.py entry points. This is a scoped fix affecting 2-3 files in the nested_json module with clear error conversion requirements.

Global exception handler in CLI entry points is a known pattern. Requires adding top-level try/except in __main__.py and/or core.py with appropriate exit status handling. Scoped to 2 files with clear requirements based on existing test patterns.
Socket error handling for DNS failures is localized to httpie/core.py or httpie/client.py. Requires enhancing existing socket.gaierror handling to cover additional error codes. Scoped to 1-2 files.
Download resume error handling is a localized fix to httpie/downloads.py. Requires checking response status codes and adding user-facing warnings. Scoped to 1 file.
Config file write error handling is a localized enhancement to httpie/config.py. Requires wrapping save operations with try/except for OSError/PermissionError. Scoped to 1 file.

File handle management in process_file_upload_arg is a scoped fix to httpie/cli/requestitems.py and likely its callers. Requires refactoring file handling (context manager or handle wrapper pattern). Affects 2-3 files in request processing flow.

Algorithm optimization in merge_all_the_people is a known pattern (set intersection). Simple refactoring with proven optimization technique. Localized to docs/contributors/fetch.py with no dependencies.
Connection pooling in fetch() is a known pattern (requests.Session reuse). Simple refactoring creating module-level Session and updating API calls. Localized to docs/contributors/fetch.py.

Debug flag caching is a deterministic optimization pattern. Simple one-time refactor to cache DEBUG environment variable at module load. Localized to docs/contributors/fetch.py with no external dependencies.

Config and context module boundary overlap is an architectural concern affecting separation of concerns. Requires consolidating configuration logic across 2 modules with ripple effects throughout the codebase (both modules are widely imported). Affects httpie/config.py, httpie/context.py, and all dependent modules.

Core module orchestration complexity is a cross-cutting architectural refactor. Requires introducing intermediate service/executor layers and reorganizing dependencies across HTTP execution pipeline. Affects httpie/core.py, httpie/client.py, httpie/downloads.py, httpie/sessions.py, and output modules (5+ files with dependency implications).

Downloads module decomposition is architectural refactoring requiring extraction of progress reporting, download state, and file handling into separate classes. While primarily httpie/downloads.py, this affects httpie/core.py (caller), output modules (progress integration), and potentially new utility modules. Requires significant restructuring.
